description: We’re a small family team building a Moon Base game for the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. Players have 10 units of battery power to keep the air, heat, greenhouse, and storm shelter running through the lunar night. Then an emergency forces them to rethink their plan. We’re combining game design, storytelling, and coding. Our team is set for this challenge.
summary: Moon Base After Dark is a browser game for junior astronauts. Players launch, take an emergency call from Earth, and land at a Moon base just before sunset. They decide how to spend limited battery power on solar panels, a greenhouse, and an airlock to get the crew safely through the lunar night.
details: Players see how much battery each response will leave them before they commit. Sending the rover to clean the panels recovers power before sunset. Saving the rover lets it move the whole crop to safety later. Players can use Back to compare strategies and customize the warning and costs. The game is a standalone HTML file with CSS and JavaScript. Download the HTML and open it in a browser to play offline. ChatGPT assisted with the browser code, CSS artwork, and illustrated demo. A Claude candidate informed the battery previews and rover trade-off. Battery costs and recharge amounts are fictional training values.
